text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains, with Ethereum slightly outpacing Bitcoin, suggesting some appetite for alternative assets despite Bitcoin's dominance holding firm at 58.3%. The Fear & Greed index at 74 and rising indicates market participants are in a confident mood, though the gains remain measured rather than euphoric. Volume of $102B sits at a healthy baseline, consistent with steady accumulation rather than panic-driven or speculative extremes.
